title: 12. Decision Trees & Random Forests
description: Construct decision trees, prevent overfitting, and aggregate trees into Random Forests.

blocks.content:
### Decision Trees & Overfitting Control

Decision Trees split data into flowchart rules using Gini Impurity or Entropy.

![Trained Decision Tree Diagram](/images/ml/chart_decision_tree.png)

#### Pruning & Random Forests
Unpruned trees memorize training data (overfitting). Random Forests solve this by training an ensemble of trees on bootstrap samples.

![Overfitting Curves](/images/ml/chart_overfitting.png)

![Feature Importance Bar Chart](/images/ml/chart_feature_importance.png)

blocks.starterCode:
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris

data = load_iris()
X, y = data.data, data.target

rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=50, max_depth=3, random_state=42)
rf.fit(X, y)

for name, imp in zip(data.feature_names, rf.feature_importances_):
    print(f'{name}: {imp:.4f}')
blocks.solutionCode:
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris

data = load_iris()
X, y = data.data, data.target
rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=50, max_depth=3, random_state=42)
rf.fit(X, y)
for name, imp in zip(data.feature_names, rf.feature_importances_):
    print(f'{name}: {imp:.4f}')
